_parser_fn_note: READ-ONLY migration, by design - this profile intentionally has NO writer_fn. parser_fn wraps settings_parser._parse_expedition_33 verbatim (config_manager/profile_functions.py) so extract_key_settings()'s profile-first branch is a zero-behaviour-change read migration. dynamic_resolution is never set by the legacy parser so it is omitted from 'settings', same convention as the GTA profile. WHY NO writer_fn, AND WHY THIS IS NOT 'JUST LIKE GTA': this game was labelled '(read-only)' in GSAA_P1_handoff.md §4.2, but direct code research during this migration found that claim was NOT actually true of the pre-existing legacy dispatch - _detect_parser_type() in settings_writer.py had no dedicated branch for 'clair obscur'/'expedition 33' at all, so Expedition 33's real GameUserSettings.ini (which genuinely contains ResolutionSizeX/FullscreenMode) fell through to the generic 'if "ResolutionSizeX" in content or "FullscreenMode" in content: return "unreal_ini"' sniff and was classified exactly like Black Myth. That meant write_settings() called directly for this title would really invoke _write_unreal_ini() and _safe_write() the file to disk - not a safe no-op like the GTA/SF6 dead-end branches. Worse, _parse_expedition_33() reads quick_preset from the sg.*Quality keys (sg.ViewDistanceQuality/sg.ShadowQuality/sg.TextureQuality/sg.EffectsQuality, excluding sg.ResolutionQuality), but _write_unreal_ini() only ever patches GPUConfigPreset for quick_preset writes - a genuine pre-existing read/write field mismatch bug that had simply never been exercised because nothing in the test suite or any real caller ever called write_settings() for this game before. Per explicit user decision (2026-11-09, after being shown this finding and asked how to proceed), this gap was fixed in the SAME change as this profile: settings_writer.py's _detect_parser_type() now has an explicit 'if "clair obscur" in name_lower or "expedition 33" in name_lower: return "unknown"' guard, mirroring the pre-existing Street Fighter 6 guard immediately above it, with a new regression test (tests/test_write_safety.py::test_expedition_33_not_routed_to_generic_unreal_writer) proving write_settings() now reports {status:'skipped', detail:"Unknown parser type for 'Clair Obscur: Expedition 33'"} and never touches the file on disk, even when the content contains ResolutionSizeX/FullscreenMode. This profile's lack of writer_fn is therefore now consistent with that corrected legacy behaviour, not masking a live bug underneath it.
